Maya (Design): uploaded a tiny tweak for the routing editor: make priority drag handle visible in compact mode + show small inline conflict label instead of global toast. quick eyes?
Owen (PM): thanks — can you paste the before/after? curious about vertical density impact.
Maya (Design): before: icons only, easy to miss. after: 16px visible grab icon + 44x44 touch hitbox; conflict shows as a 1-line badge with "Conflict: Allow - billing" and a CTA "Show conflict details". keeps height same.
Kai (Frontend): +1. implementation note: will add a visually-hidden label `aria-label="Drag to reorder"`. for the conflict CTA, prefer a button with `aria-expanded` when details open.
Ruth (Eng): backend can include `conflict_summary` (<=120 chars) in policy validate endpoint. perf ok. prefer we lazy-load full diff only when user clicks details.
Ben (A11y): a11y notes: SR announce must be full sentence. e.g., "Conflict detected: rule 'Block - large files' conflicts with 'Allow - billing'." use role=status + aria-atomic=true. also ensure focusable controls meet 3:1 contrast.
Maya (Design): good call. will change badge copy to full sentence for SR and keep compact visual. updating mock to #004EA8 for contrast.
Kai (Frontend): small CSS proposal for preview highlight: `.rule-row--preview { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var(--accent); transition: box-shadow .25s; }` throttle to avoid perf hits.
Ruth (Eng): agree on throttling. we'll only return match snippet for first simulated request by default.
ux-bot: Created ticket: product/routing-ui#4287 - "compact: visible drag handle, inline conflict badge, preview match highlight"
Maya (Design): thanks all 44d can we review quick tomorrow 9:15?
Owen (PM): scheduled.
